CREATE MASTER key ENCRYPTION by password = '$#%$^&%#%@$#&%^%#'

---------------------------------
--Database scoped credential
---------------------------------
create DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL omar_creds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

----------------------------------
--Extarnal Data Source
----------------------------------
create EXTERNAL data SOURCE silver_source
with 
(
LOCATION ='https://...windows.net/silver/',
CREDENTIAL = _creds
)


create EXTERNAL data SOURCE gold_source
with 
(
LOCATION ='https://electronicstoredwhlake.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/',
CREDENTIAL = omar_creds

)
-----------------------------------
--Extarnal file format
----------------------------------

create EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta
WITH 
(
    FORMAT_TYPE =DELTA,
)
